notices.title: Exit liquidity depends on Falcon USDf
notices.message: AA_FalconXUSDC is the senior tranche of a CDO over Falcon Finance USDf-collateralised Morpho markets. USDC redemption rates and exit timing are tied to USDf's mint/burn liquidity; sustained USDf stress can degrade vault liquidity even when the senior tranche absorbs no principal loss.
